summary: Verstappen carries a grid penalty into Mexico City after a heated practice collision with Lawson, intensifying pressure on the championship leader as rivals circle. Haas scrambles with Hirakawa stepping in for the sidelined Ocon, injecting unpredictability into midfield battles and strategic calculations. A strong result here could seal Antonelli's maiden world title, making the high-altitude Mexico City circuit a potential coronation stage for the McLaren driver despite his illness absence from media duties.
